## 12. Review Checklist

- [ ] Scope and exclusions are accurate.
- [ ] Deliverables exist and links resolve.
- [ ] Architectural impact is explicit.
- [ ] Governance impact and non-effects are explicit.
- [ ] Programme status and sequence align with the Master Programme.
- [ ] Repository and commit state are explicit.
- [ ] Validation evidence supports the reported result.
- [ ] Outstanding risks are visible.
- [ ] Founder decisions required are exact.
- [ ] Exactly one next work package is recommended, or none.
- [ ] Recommendation is not represented as authorisation.
- [ ] Section 13 remains uncompleted by the coding agent.
